Subject: Title calibration request: candidate DP-8342 — L5 Manager vs Staff

Hi Marissa / Tessa,

We have a strong finish on Daniel Park (GreenLeaf AI) for Staff Software Engineer -> he interviewed as a senior IC but has management experience and will be operating as the first manager on a small new team (3 direct reports + dotted-oversight for a contractor). Given the org needs and his drive to hire/mentor, I think we should offer as L5 Manager rather than Staff.

Request details:
- Proposed level/title: L5 (Manager)
- Base asked: $210,000 (his target) — current L5 cap for role is $195,000
- Target equity: 0.50% (band typical 0.35%)
- Total OTE (first-year comp): ~$280k (including sign-on)

I'm attaching a comp override form with rationale and the role profile. We expect the org to grow quickly and Daniel will be owning hiring for the new subteam. Hiring timeline is tight; he has two other offers and is finalizing this week. Can we get an expedited leveling + comp exception decision?

Attachments:
- comp_override_form.pdf (filled)

Thanks — Marcus

Marcus Lin

Marcus — thanks for the note and the form. Quick follow-ups before I loop in Compensation: 
1) Can you add the org chart (direct reports + dotted lines) and a 6-month hiring plan? We need to confirm the managerial scope justifies L5.
2) Is headcount already approved on the hiring plan or do we need HC sign-off from Finance? If HC is pending, we can’t approve comp over-band until HC is committed.
3) Please confirm whether the request is for a permanent level change or a manager-in-training step-up after 6 months — that affects the equity ask.

I ran a quick numbers pass in the attached calculator; if we approve base $210k + 0.50% equity we should flag this as a one-off comp exception. I’ll ping Compensation (Laura) and Compensation Ops (Neha) for leveling + band harmonization.

Attachments: offer_calculator.xlsx (salary/equity scenarios)

—Marissa

Thanks — saw the initial packet. A few points from People Ops/levelling rubric:
- Policy: L5 Manager is typically reserved for managers with ongoing hiring responsibility and >=3 direct reports or clear hiring scope.
- Precedent: We have approved manager-level exceptions when the candidate brings both high IC impact + leadership scope; each case requires manager+director signoff and a one-time comp exception approval from Compensation.

If Marcus can provide the org chart and confirm HC is committed, People Ops are OK to recommend L5 Manager. Neha — please advise on the band/eq delta and whether we should re-anchor the role at an alternate comp band to avoid blowing the comp budget for the entire org.

Action items:
- Marcus: upload org chart and HC approval memo to the GH record.
- Neha: review comp bands and advise final numbers by EOD.

- Condition: HC must be approved and the role needs a manager development plan in the GH job posting (6-month check-in to confirm manager effectiveness).

I'll mark the GH offer with a provisional comp exception flag (GH ID GH-8342) and add the harmonization notes. If People Ops confirms HC, I approve moving forward with the proposed package with the adjustment to equity.
